members.name: value
members.description: Combobox is a direct alias of ComboboxPrimitive.Root. Its generic selected value/defaultValue and onValueChange are distinct from inputValue/defaultInputValue/onInputValueChange, highlight and open callbacks. multiple changes values to arrays. Root items supplies filtering/Collection/Empty; default filtering is source locale-aware matching, autoHighlight=false, modal=false, and query changes alone do not commit a value. filteredItems/filter=null support explicit caller filtering; object values use itemToStringLabel/itemToStringValue and Object.is comparison unless overridden. Root autoComplete is a browser autofill hint (mapped to formAutoComplete), not the internal list/inline autocompletion mode. Input wraps the actual primitive input in InputGroup, defaults showTrigger=true/showClear=false and disabled=false; Content defaults bottom/start, offsets6/0 with optional anchor. List is listbox, Item is option, and virtual focus remains on input via aria-activedescendant. Empty requires Root items and keeps a polite status element mounted while changing its children. Group/Collection/Separator and useComboboxAnchor are concrete public parts. In multiple mode an accepted item press stays open when not filtering; filtering with input outside the popup closes it, while input-inside-popup clears the query with input-clear/isItemPress details. Multiple mode uses Chips/Chip/ChipsInput and source chip keyboard/removal behavior; showRemove defaults true. The private icon-only Clear/automatic trigger and automatic chip-remove wrappers expose no instance-specific label props. The chosen reference sets showTrigger=false/showClear=false and showRemove=false, composing explicitly named exported Trigger and named Base UI Clear/ChipRemove where needed. These are transparent caller compositions, not fictitious new shadcn exports. The reference opts auxiliary actions into native Tab order with explicit tabIndex=0; their source defaults are -1. Disabled/readOnly block value edits but readOnly still allows popup browsing. A canceled Combobox item-selection transaction returns before its dependent close, unlike Select which separately requests closing. Clearing selected/query state and popup dismissal use distinct cancellable source callback transactions; host-controlled props remain authoritative.
